purpose: One-rule exploratory calibration-to-other-region utility check; not a novel algorithm or untouched-data confirmation
rule: Choose old_su_guard iff both guard policies are feasible in the calibration region and old_su_guard has at least one fewer calibration error; otherwise choose current_su_guard
calibration_region: The evaluation region of the reverse fold, which exactly equals the target fold calibration region
continuation_gate: Both directions must have all 20 cases feasible; chosen policy versus fixed current_su_guard must reduce mean errors by at least 1 and at least 10 percent in each direction. Otherwise do not expand this same rule into new training.
limits: Both regions and existing results already inspected; exploratory only
Mask repetitions are dependent, no iid significance claim
A calibration selector is ordinary policy selection, not itself an innovation
Archive cost still required to calculate history and guard
All budgets, conditions and failed cases retained; no tuning after outcomes
